statement: As a user, I want to add a task in a couple of seconds, so that capturing a thought never interrupts me.
As a user, I want to be reminded when a task is due, so that I don't have to remember it.
As a user, I want the same tasks on my iPhone and my iPad, so that I can use whichever is at hand.
As a user, I want to see what is due today from the home screen, so that I don't have to open the app.
As a user, I want my tasks to stay private, so that nobody else can read my list.
As a user, I want to group tasks into lists, so that groceries and work don't mix.
As a household member, I want to share a list with my partner, so that we shop from the same list.
As a household member, I want to see who ticked off an item, so that we don't buy it twice.
